fields.Name: T075 - Saved View Selector Browse and Select
fields.Description: Exercises the saved-view (mj-view-selector) read/select lifecycle over the User Views entity — distinct from saved QUERIES (already covered) and from all AG-Grid interactions.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and go to Data Explorer > Data. Open the 'Products' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box (type 'Products', click the exact match). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. In the view toolbar at the top-left of the records area, click the saved-view selector button (a layer-group icon labeled with the current view name or '(Default)') to open the Views panel. Verify the panel opens listing at least a '(Default)' option (plus any 'My Views' / 'Shared With Me' sections). Click the '(Default)' option (or any listed view). Success is the panel opening and the chosen option applying (a checkmark on it and the grid reloading).

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking the saved-view selector opens a Views panel showing at least the '(Default)' entry
Selecting a view applies it — a check indicator appears on the chosen view and the grid reloads (or a valid empty-state renders)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
